rationale: The benchmark candidate is structured_delivery because the supplied scope affects product semantics, runtime, release behavior, and six canonical owners. Deterministic propagation is absent despite derived assets, making a compact path unsafe. This classification is non-authorizing and is not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
The change affects product semantics, runtime, and release behavior.
Six canonical owners, eight source paths, and eight derived paths indicate cross-owner and distribution complexity.
Derived paths exist but deterministic propagation is false.
verified_change is ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner, no release impact, and deterministic-to-e
compact_delivery is ineligible because no completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task context is supplied.
Any impact beyond the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
